anomalies.description: Sustained violent group clash involving large numbers of riot police in full gear confronting a dense crowd; includes pushing, shoving, falling, and use of force, escalating into physical fights and abuse incidents.
Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat, including punching, grappling, and pushing, with police and civilians intermingled in the scuffle.
A person is on the ground being struck and restrained by multiple individuals (including uniformed officers and civilians), while appearing unable to defend themselves.

Large crowd of civilians confronts a line of riot police in green helmets and protective gear; there is sustained pushing, gesturing (including peace signs), and close physical proximity indicating collective violent unrest.

Sustained violent group clash between a crowd of civilians and a line of riot police in full protective gear; includes aggressive posturing, raised hands (including peace signs as provocation), shoving, and physical restraint attempts over multiple seconds.; Sustained confrontation between a group of civilians (including individuals filming, shouting, and advancing) and a line of riot police in a confined indoor space (likely a transit station). The interaction escalates from verbal/physical provocation to pushing, shoving, and use of force (e.g., baton-like object raised at f13), indicating collective violent unrest.

A bald man in a black shirt engages in mutual physical combat with a riot police officer: the man pushes or strikes the officer while the officer reciprocates with a shove or strike, as seen in frames f4–f7.

A bald man in black repeatedly gestures and pushes toward a line of riot police; officers respond with defensive postures and counter-movements, including one officer extending an arm to push back. Physical contact occurs between the man and at least one officer around 18.5–19.5s.

The same bald man again physically confronts a riot police officer, extending his arm toward the officer’s face/upper body while the officer raises an arm in response; this appears to be a second distinct exchange of force (frames f12–f15).

An officer appears to strike or forcefully shove a civilian (wearing blue jacket) who is partially turned away and not actively resisting at that moment; the action resembles disproportionate force against a non-combatant in the immediate aftermath of the main clash.
